description: This PHP class `HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeParam` is responsible for validating and transforming name/value pairs in param tags used with safe objects, specifically supporting Flash objects by enforcing certain attribute values based on configuration and input.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeParam
classes.description: A class that validates name/value pairs for param tags in safe objects, primarily for Flash support, preprocessing and enforcing attribute values based on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with specific attribute definitions for URI and window modes.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms and validates input attributes based on their name, enforcing specific values or defaulting to null for unsupported attributes.
